pick.headline: Egyptian editor Yusuf al-Sibai assassinated in Nicosia
pick.summary: On 18 February 1978 the Egyptian editor Yusuf al-Sibai, a close associate of President Sadat, was shot dead in Nicosia by Palestinian gunmen who then took hostages and seized an airliner.
pick.significance: The killing was revenge for Sadat's peace initiative toward Israel. It led to the deadly Egyptian commando raid at Larnaca the next day.
